source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: All 80 selected original verse records bind exactly once to matching public verse labels. No record partition or offset in this scope. Titles remain inside their verse labels.

delta_method: F0 retained wording; F1 lexical; F2 syntax/idiom; F3 consequential interpretive, textual, social, or versification choice. Editorial choices are independent of overlap scores. No minimum-change quota. Independent review has not occurred.

verses.rationale: Keeps praise title, royal address, and enduring blessing.
verses.before: I will extol you, my God and King, and bless your name forever and ever.
verses.after: A song of praise. Of David. I will exalt you, my God and King, and bless your name forever and ever.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will extol you, my God and King, and bless your name forever and ever.

verses.rationale: Preserves daily and everlasting rhythms.
verses.before: Every day I will bless you and praise your name forever and ever.
verses.after: Every day I will bless you and praise your name forever and ever.
verses.tsw_comparator: Every day I will bless you and praise your name forever and ever.

verses.rationale: Keeps praise and unsearchable greatness.
verses.before: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, and his greatness is unsearchable.
verses.after: The LORD is great and worthy of abundant praise; his greatness is beyond searching out.
verses.tsw_comparator: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, and his greatness is unsearchable.

verses.rationale: Preserves generational transmission.
verses.before: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
verses.after: One generation commends your works to another; they tell of your mighty deeds.
verses.tsw_comparator: One generation shall commend your works to another, and shall declare your mighty acts.

verses.rationale: Keeps layered majesty and narrated wonders.
verses.before: On the glorious splendor of your majesty, and on your wondrous works, I will meditate.
verses.after: I will ponder the glorious splendor of your majesty and the accounts of your wonders.
verses.tsw_comparator: On the glorious splendor of your majesty, and on your wondrous works, I will meditate.

verses.rationale: Follows singular read form greatness and preserves they/I movement.
verses.before: They will speak of the might of your awesome deeds, and I will declare your greatness.
verses.after: They speak of the power of your fearsome acts; I will recount your greatness.
verses.tsw_comparator: They shall speak of the might of your awesome deeds, and I will declare your greatness.

verses.rationale: Preserves overflowing speech and righteous praise.
verses.before: They will pour forth the fame of your abundant goodness and will sing aloud of your righteousness.
verses.after: They pour out remembrance of your abundant goodness and sing joyfully of your righteousness.
verses.tsw_comparator: They shall pour forth the fame of your abundant goodness and shall sing aloud of your righteousness.

verses.rationale: Keeps the recurring divine-character formula.
verses.before: The LORD is gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love.
verses.after: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and great in faithful love.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD is gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love.

verses.rationale: Preserves broad creaturely scope.
verses.before: The LORD is good to all, and his mercy is over all that he has made.
verses.after: The LORD is good to all; his compassion reaches all he has made.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD is good to all, and his mercy is over all that he has made.

verses.rationale: Keeps all works and faithful ones distinct.
verses.before: All your works will give thanks to you, O LORD, and all your faithful ones will bless you!
verses.after: All you have made will thank you, LORD; your faithful ones will bless you.
verses.tsw_comparator: All your works shall give thanks to you, O LORD, and all your faithful ones shall bless you!

verses.rationale: Carries speech toward its purpose in the next verse.
verses.before: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom and tell of your power,
verses.after: They will speak of your kingdom’s glory and tell of your might,
verses.tsw_comparator: They shall speak of the glory of your kingdom and tell of your power,

verses.rationale: Preserves shift from your to his.
verses.before: to reveal to the children of humanity your mighty deeds, and the glorious splendor of your kingdom.
verses.after: to make his mighty deeds known to humanity and the glorious splendor of his kingdom.
verses.tsw_comparator: to make known to the children of humanity your mighty deeds, and the glorious splendor of your kingdom.

verses.rationale: Follows pinned Hebrew without adding the absent nun line.
verses.before: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures throughout all generations.
verses.after: Your kingdom is a kingdom for all ages; your rule lasts through every generation.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures throughout all generations.

verses.rationale: Keeps both all clauses and bodily reversal.
verses.before: The LORD upholds everyone who are falling and raises up everyone who are bowed down.
verses.after: The LORD supports all who fall and raises all who are bowed down.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD upholds all who are falling and raises up all who are bowed down.

verses.rationale: Preserves expectant eyes and timely feeding.
verses.before: The eyes of all look to you, and you give them their food in due season.
verses.after: The eyes of all look to you in hope; you give them their food at the right time.
verses.tsw_comparator: The eyes of all look to you, and you give them their food in due season.

verses.rationale: Keeps open hand and nonhuman-inclusive life.
verses.before: You open your hand; you satisfy the desire of every living thing.
verses.after: You open your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
verses.tsw_comparator: You open your hand; you satisfy the desire of every living thing.

verses.rationale: Preserves ways/deeds and both attributes.
verses.before: The LORD is righteous in all his ways and kind in all his works.
verses.after: The LORD is righteous in all his ways and faithful in all he does.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD is righteous in all his ways and kind in all his works.

verses.rationale: Keeps repeated call with qualifying truth.
verses.before: The LORD is near to everyone who call on him, to everyone who call on him in truth.
verses.after: The LORD is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

verses.rationale: Preserves desire, hearing, and rescue.
verses.before: He fulfills the desire of people who fear him; he also hears their cry and saves them.
verses.after: He fulfills the desire of those who fear him; he hears their cry and saves them.
verses.tsw_comparator: He fulfills the desire of those who fear him; he also hears their cry and saves them.

verses.rationale: Keeps protective and destructive actions explicit.
verses.before: The LORD preserves everyone who love him, but all the wicked he will destroy.
verses.after: The LORD guards all who love him, but he destroys all the wicked.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD preserves all who love him, but all the wicked he will destroy.

verses.rationale: Preserves bodily voice and all-flesh invitation.
verses.before: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD, and let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
verses.after: My mouth will speak the LORD’s praise; let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
verses.tsw_comparator: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD, and let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.

verses.rationale: Retains both divine-name forms and self-address.
verses.before: Hallelujah! Praise LORD, O my soul.
verses.after: Praise **YAH**! Praise the LORD, my whole being.
verses.tsw_comparator: Hallelujah! Praise LORD, O my soul.

verses.rationale: Keeps lifelong praise in two parallel clauses.
verses.before: I will praise the LORD while I live; I will sing praises to my God while I have being.
verses.after: I will praise the LORD as long as I live; I will make music for my God while I have breath.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will praise the LORD while I live; I will sing praises to my God while I have being.

verses.rationale: Preserves authority and mortality as unreliable rescue.
verses.before: Do not trust in princes, in a human being who cannot save.
verses.after: Do not put your trust in nobles, in a human being who cannot save.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not trust in princes, in a human being who cannot save.

verses.rationale: Keeps breath/ground and same-day loss of plans.
verses.before: His spirit departs, he returns to the earth; in that very day, his plans perish.
verses.after: His breath departs; he returns to his ground. That very day his plans perish.
verses.tsw_comparator: His spirit departs, he returns to the earth; in that very day, his plans perish.

verses.rationale: Preserves ancestral identity and help/hope pair.
verses.before: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,
verses.after: Happy is the one whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope rests on the LORD his God,
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,

verses.rationale: Keeps creation's scope and continuing fidelity.
verses.before: who made heaven and earth, the sea and all that is in them; who keeps faith forever;
verses.after: the maker of heaven and earth, the sea and everything in them, who keeps faith forever,
verses.tsw_comparator: who made heaven and earth, the sea and all that is in them; who keeps faith forever;

verses.rationale: Preserves concrete justice, food, and release.
verses.before: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. the LORD frees the prisoners;
verses.after: who brings justice to the oppressed and gives bread to the hungry. The LORD sets prisoners free.
verses.tsw_comparator: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. the LORD frees the prisoners;

verses.rationale: Keeps three repeated divine names and distinct acts.
verses.before: LORD opens the eyes of the blind; the LORD lifts up people who are bowed down; the LORD loves the righteous;
verses.after: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind; the LORD raises those bowed down; the LORD loves the righteous.
verses.tsw_comparator: LORD opens the eyes of the blind; the LORD lifts up those who are bowed down; the LORD loves the righteous;

verses.rationale: Preserves three vulnerable groups and reversed wicked path.
verses.before: the LORD watches over the strangers; He upholds the orphan and widow, but the way of the wicked He brings to ruin.
verses.after: The LORD guards resident foreigners; he sustains the fatherless and the widow, but he frustrates the way of the wicked.
verses.tsw_comparator: the LORD watches over the strangers; He upholds the orphan and widow, but the way of the wicked He brings to ruin.

verses.rationale: Keeps address to Zion and concluding short name.
verses.before: the LORD will reign forever, your God, O Zion, to all generations. Hallelujah!
verses.after: The LORD will reign forever, your God, Zion, through every generation. Praise **YAH**!
verses.tsw_comparator: the LORD will reign forever, your God, O Zion, to all generations. Hallelujah!

verses.rationale: Preserves goodness, pleasure, and fitting praise.
verses.before: Praise the LORD! For it is good to make music to our God; for praise is pleasant and fitting.
verses.after: Praise **YAH**! How good it is to make music for our God; how pleasant and fitting praise is!
verses.tsw_comparator: Praise the LORD! For it is good to make music to our God; for praise is pleasant and fitting.

verses.rationale: Keeps city restoration and displaced people together.
verses.before: The LORD builds Jerusalem and gathers the outcasts of Israel.
verses.after: The LORD rebuilds Jerusalem; he gathers Israel’s scattered people.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD builds Jerusalem and gathers the outcasts of Israel.

verses.rationale: Retains inward hurt and bodily care imagery.
verses.before: God heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verses.after: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verses.tsw_comparator: God heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

verses.rationale: Preserves counting and individual naming.
verses.before: God counts the number of the stars and calls them all by name.
verses.after: He counts the stars and calls each one by name.
verses.tsw_comparator: God counts the number of the stars and calls them all by name.

verses.rationale: Keeps Adonai and uncountable understanding.
verses.before: Great is our Lord and abundant in power; God’s understanding is beyond measure.
verses.after: Our Lord is great and mighty in power; his understanding is beyond measure.
verses.tsw_comparator: Great is our Lord and abundant in power; God’s understanding is beyond measure.

verses.rationale: Preserves social reversal and forceful abasement.
verses.before: The LORD lifts up the humble and brings the wicked down to the ground.
verses.after: The LORD sustains the humble but brings the wicked down to the ground.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD lifts up the humble and brings the wicked down to the ground.

verses.rationale: Keeps both musical acts and instrument.
verses.before: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music to our God with the lyre.
verses.after: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music for our God on the lyre.
verses.tsw_comparator: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music to our God with the lyre.

verses.rationale: Preserves weather-to-growth sequence.
verses.before: God covers the heavens with clouds, prepares rain for the earth, and makes grass grow on the hills.
verses.after: He covers the heavens with clouds, prepares rain for the earth, and makes grass grow on the mountains.
verses.tsw_comparator: God covers the heavens with clouds, prepares rain for the earth, and makes grass grow on the hills.

verses.rationale: Keeps nonhuman provision and crying birds.
verses.before: God gives the animals their food, and the young ravens when they cry.
verses.after: He gives animals their food and feeds the young ravens when they cry.
verses.tsw_comparator: God gives the animals their food, and the young ravens when they cry.

verses.rationale: Retains concrete military/athletic strength images.
verses.before: God does not delight in the strength of the horse or take pleasure in the legs of a warrior.
verses.after: He does not delight in the horse’s strength or take pleasure in a man’s legs.
verses.tsw_comparator: God does not delight in the strength of the horse or take pleasure in the legs of a warrior.

verses.rationale: Keeps fear and hopeful waiting together.
verses.before: The LORD takes pleasure in people who fear God, in people who hope in God’s steadfast love.
verses.after: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, who wait in hope for his faithful love.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear God, in those who hope in God’s steadfast love.

verses.rationale: Preserves paired city addresses.
verses.before: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
verses.after: Jerusalem, extol the LORD; Zion, praise your God.
verses.tsw_comparator: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!

verses.rationale: Keeps defense and inhabitants' flourishing.
verses.before: For God strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses your children within you.
verses.after: For he strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses your children within you.
verses.tsw_comparator: For God strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses your children within you.

verses.rationale: Preserves territory, peace, and rich food.
verses.before: God grants peace within your borders and satisfies you with the finest wheat.
verses.after: He establishes peace within your borders and satisfies you with the finest wheat.
verses.tsw_comparator: God grants peace within your borders and satisfies you with the finest wheat.

verses.rationale: Keeps spoken command personified as runner.
verses.before: God sends the command to the earth; God’s word runs swiftly.
verses.after: He sends his utterance to the earth; his word runs swiftly.
verses.tsw_comparator: God sends the command to the earth; God’s word runs swiftly.

verses.rationale: Preserves two familiar-material comparisons.
verses.before: God gives snow like wool and scatters frost like ashes.
verses.after: He gives snow like wool and scatters frost like ashes.
verses.tsw_comparator: God gives snow like wool and scatters frost like ashes.

verses.rationale: Keeps ice fragments and rhetorical question.
verses.before: God casts down ice like crumbs; who can stand before God’s cold?
verses.after: He hurls his ice like crumbs; who can stand before his cold?
verses.tsw_comparator: God casts down ice like crumbs; who can stand before God’s cold?

verses.rationale: Preserves thaw's speech/wind sequence.
verses.before: God sends the word and melts them; God makes the wind blow, and the waters flow.
verses.after: He sends his word and melts them; he makes his wind blow, and water flows.
verses.tsw_comparator: God sends the word and melts them; God makes the wind blow, and the waters flow.

verses.rationale: Follows plural read form words and distinct instruction terms.
verses.before: God declares the word to Jacob, God’s statutes and judgments to Israel.
verses.after: He declares his words to Jacob, his decrees and judgments to Israel.
verses.tsw_comparator: God declares the word to Jacob, God’s statutes and judgments to Israel.

verses.rationale: Keeps Israel's particular gift without adding conclusions about outsiders.
verses.before: God has not dealt this way with any other nation; as for the judgments, they have not known them. Praise the LORD!
verses.after: He has not done this for any other nation; they do not know his judgments. Praise **YAH**!
verses.tsw_comparator: God has not dealt this way with any other nation; as for the judgments, they have not known them. Praise the LORD!

verses.rationale: Preserves short/full names and heavenly setting.
verses.before: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise God in the heights!
verses.after: Praise **YAH**! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise him in the heights.
verses.tsw_comparator: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise God in the heights!

verses.rationale: Follows plural read form armies and preserves both calls.
verses.before: Praise God, all God’s angels; praise God, all God’s hosts!
verses.after: Praise him, all his messengers; praise him, all his armies.
verses.tsw_comparator: Praise God, all God’s angels; praise God, all God’s hosts!

verses.rationale: Keeps addressed heavenly lights.
verses.before: Praise God, sun and moon; praise God, all shining stars!
verses.after: Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all you shining stars.
verses.tsw_comparator: Praise God, sun and moon; praise God, all shining stars!

verses.rationale: Preserves ancient upper-water image.
verses.before: Praise God, highest heavens, and waters above the heavens!
verses.after: Praise him, highest heavens, and you waters above the heavens.
verses.tsw_comparator: Praise God, highest heavens, and waters above the heavens!

verses.rationale: Keeps creation by command as reason.
verses.before: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for God commanded, and they were created.
verses.after: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for he commanded, and they were created.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for God commanded, and they were created.

verses.rationale: Takes enduring decree reading while noting alternate subject.
verses.before: God established them forever and ever and gave a decree that will not pass away.
verses.after: He established them forever and ever; he gave a decree that will not pass away.
verses.tsw_comparator: God established them forever and ever and gave a decree that shall not pass away.

verses.rationale: Keeps monsters and watery deeps as summoned creatures.
verses.before: Praise the LORD from the earth, you sea monsters and all the deeps,
verses.after: Praise the LORD from the earth, you sea monsters and all the depths,
verses.tsw_comparator: Praise the LORD from the earth, you sea monsters and all the deeps,

verses.rationale: Preserves varied weather and obedient wind.
verses.before: fire and hail, snow and smoke, storm wind fulfilling God’s word,
verses.after: fire and hail, snow and mist, storm wind carrying out his word,
verses.tsw_comparator: fire and hail, snow and smoke, storm wind fulfilling God’s word,

verses.rationale: Keeps terrain and cultivated/wild trees.
verses.before: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
verses.after: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
verses.tsw_comparator: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

verses.rationale: Preserves four animal groups.
verses.before: wild animals and all livestock, creeping things and winged birds,
verses.after: wild animals and all livestock, creeping creatures and winged birds,
verses.tsw_comparator: wild animals and all livestock, creeping things and winged birds,

verses.rationale: Keeps ordinary peoples amid governing groups.
verses.before: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,
verses.after: earth’s kings and all peoples, rulers and all the earth’s judges,
verses.tsw_comparator: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,

verses.rationale: Preserves sex and age pairings.
verses.before: young men and young women together, the old with the young.
verses.after: young men and young women together, old people and children.
verses.tsw_comparator: young men and young women together, the old with the young.

verses.rationale: Keeps sole exaltation and cosmic scope.
verses.before: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for God’s name alone is exalted; God’s splendor is over earth and heaven.
verses.after: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for his name alone is exalted; his majesty is above earth and heaven.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for God’s name alone is exalted; God’s splendor is over earth and heaven.

verses.rationale: Retains horn image and close covenant people.
verses.before: God has raised up a horn for the people, praise for all the faithful ones, for the children of Israel, a people near to God. Praise the LORD!
verses.after: He has raised a horn for his people, praise for all his faithful ones, for the people of Israel, the people close to him. Praise **YAH**!
verses.tsw_comparator: God has raised up a horn for the people, praise for all the faithful ones, for the children of Israel, a people near to God. Praise the LORD!

verses.rationale: Preserves new song and gathered community.
verses.before: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the faithful!
verses.after: Praise **YAH**! Sing a new song to the LORD, his praise in the assembly of his faithful ones.
verses.tsw_comparator: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the faithful!

verses.rationale: Keeps maker/king and Israel/Zion parallels.
verses.before: Let Israel be glad in his Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King!
verses.after: Let Israel rejoice in its maker; let Zion’s children celebrate their king.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let Israel be glad in his Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King!

verses.rationale: Preserves embodied celebration and both instruments.
verses.before: Let them praise his name with dancing, making melody to him with tambourine and lyre!
verses.after: Let them praise his name with dancing and make music for him with tambourine and lyre.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let them praise his name with dancing, making melody to him with tambourine and lyre!

verses.rationale: Keeps delight and clothing/adornment image.
verses.before: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people; he adorns the humble with salvation.
verses.after: For the LORD delights in his people; he adorns the humble with salvation.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people; he adorns the humble with salvation.

verses.rationale: Preserves surprising bed setting rather than replacing it with battlefield.
verses.before: Let the faithful exult in glory; let them sing for joy on their beds.
verses.after: Let his faithful ones exult in honor and shout for joy on their beds.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let the faithful exult in glory; let them sing for joy on their beds.

verses.rationale: Keeps praise and weapon together without spiritualizing sword.
verses.before: Let the high praises of God be in their throats and two-edged swords in their hands,
verses.after: Let high praises of God be in their throats and a double-edged sword in their hands,
verses.tsw_comparator: Let the high praises of God be in their throats and two-edged swords in their hands,

verses.rationale: Preserves punitive purpose and plural populations.
verses.before: to execute vengeance on the nations and punishments on the peoples,
verses.after: to carry out vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,
verses.tsw_comparator: to execute vengeance on the nations and punishments on the peoples,

verses.rationale: Keeps rulers' confinement and iron restraints.
verses.before: to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with fetters of iron,
verses.after: to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with iron shackles,
verses.tsw_comparator: to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with fetters of iron,

verses.rationale: Preserves written judgment without inventing its documentary reference.
verses.before: to execute on them the judgment written. This is honor for all his faithful ones. Praise the LORD!
verses.after: to carry out on them the written judgment. This is honor for all his faithful ones. Praise **YAH**!
verses.tsw_comparator: to execute on them the judgment written. This is honor for all his faithful ones. Praise the LORD!

verses.rationale: Keeps holy place and cosmic expanse distinct.
verses.before: Praise the LORD! Praise God in the sanctuary; praise God in the firmament of divine power!
verses.after: Praise **YAH**! Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty expanse.
verses.tsw_comparator: Praise the LORD! Praise God in the sanctuary; praise God in the firmament of divine power!

verses.rationale: Preserves deeds and greatness as grounds.
verses.before: Praise God for mighty deeds; praise God according to abundant greatness!
verses.after: Praise him for his mighty deeds; praise him according to his immense greatness.
verses.tsw_comparator: Praise God for mighty deeds; praise God according to abundant greatness!

verses.rationale: Keeps shofar and two stringed instruments.
verses.before: Praise God with the blast of the horn; praise God with lute and harp!
verses.after: Praise him with a ram’s-horn blast; praise him with harp and lyre.
verses.tsw_comparator: Praise God with the blast of the horn; praise God with lute and harp!

verses.rationale: Preserves dance and distinct musical groupings.
verses.before: Praise God with tambourine and dance; praise God with strings and pipe!
verses.after: Praise him with tambourine and dancing; praise him with strings and pipe.
verses.tsw_comparator: Praise God with tambourine and dance; praise God with strings and pipe!

verses.rationale: Keeps repeated instrument and intensified sound.
verses.before: Praise God with sounding cymbals; praise God with clashing cymbals!
verses.after: Praise him with ringing cymbals; praise him with crashing cymbals.
verses.tsw_comparator: Praise God with sounding cymbals; praise God with clashing cymbals!

verses.rationale: Preserves broad breathing-life invitation and both short names.
verses.before: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
verses.after: Let everything that breathes praise **YAH**. Praise **YAH**!
verses.tsw_comparator: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!

comparative_references.scope: All 80 TSW verses read after independent drafting from each selected Hebrew record and all annotations. Shared wording retained where clear; overlap is triage only.
